title: Are you coming, you fellows?
html_source: If you can get hold of a good audiobook version of Ulysses—there are several, but they’re usually pretty expensive—you can hear more starkly the differences between English Haines and Irish Mulligan and Stephen. Jim Norton’s rendering is very good: in this bit of dialogue Haines’s “Oxford manner” is particularly noticeable, with plummy accent and diction.
